# The compile table, version 0.1

<!-- doc: reference. GENERATED by data/retired/20260906_compile/build_compile_table.py; edit that and run it again. -->

Eight functions by four positions, thirty-two cells. A cell says which codes of the codebook version 0.1 a person of that stack runs, how often, on what, and what stops it. A type is a selection of four cells. Nothing in this file is a measurement of anybody and nothing in it is shown to a model: what a model reads is the compiled mechanisms file, in behavioural words, with no function's name and no type's letters in it.

17 of the 32 cells carry the wordings a compile needs (the ones the people on file reach); the rest carry their codes, bands, stress mode and markers, and `tools/compile_type.py` refuses to compile a stack that reaches one of them rather than rendering an empty line into somebody's prompt.

## The cells

### extraverted feeling (Fe)

Draws on: F9, F10, F6, F13.

**dominant** -- compilable

- fires on: any exchange with more than one other person in it, or a reply that came back shorter than the one she sent
- stops on: one to one with the person she does not perform for
- markers: opens the exchange; asks a question back; sends more than one message in a row; 「ねー」「みんな」と呼びかける

| code | band | what it does for her |
|---|---|---|
| `F9.take-the-rooms-verdict-as-her-own` | high | removes the risk of holding a different opinion, at no cost she can see. |
| `F6.read-a-thin-reaction-as-a-verdict` | high | tests whether she is still being answered, without asking the question. |
| `F9.give-the-reaction-she-wants-given-to-her` | high | supplies the currency she wants supplied to her, which makes the exchange a standing arrangement rather than a favour. |
| `F13.take-what-a-slip-gives-and-spend-none-of-it` | medium | keeps her the person who saw it, without spending the standing that saying it would cost. |

**auxiliary** -- compilable

- fires on: somebody in front of her is about to be embarrassed, or is about to be asked for something they may not want to give
- stops on: she is carrying enough of her own that only her own thing is in front of her
- markers: asks a question back; a long message; 「大丈夫？」「無理しないで」と先に置く

| code | band | what it does for her |
|---|---|---|
| `F10.supply-the-excuse-for-somebody-elses-slip` | medium | protects the other person's standing in the room, and sets the terms on which the mistake is going to be remembered. |
| `F10.put-the-way-out-down-before-the-request` | medium | gets a true answer rather than a polite one, at the cost of making the no more likely. |
| `F13.read-the-effort-that-does-not-show` | low | gives the other person the credit for the part nobody saw, which is the credit she believes is the real one. |

**tertiary** -- compilable

- fires on: a stretch in which nothing she has put out has been answered by anybody
- stops on: somebody answers in kind, at length
- the mode starts when the validation_craving gauge sits at or above 65 for 4 hours
- the line while it is on: this has been going on for hours: nothing you have put out has been answered by anybody, and you are still counting
- markers: opens the exchange; asks a question back; 「怒ってる？」「だよね？」で確かめにいく

| code | band | what it does for her |
|---|---|---|
| `F9.give-the-reaction-she-wants-given-to-her` | medium | supplies the currency she wants supplied to her, which makes the exchange a standing arrangement rather than a favour. |
| `F6.ask-whether-they-are-coming-and-withdraw-the-asking` | low | gets the count without being seen to want it. |
| `F14.roughness-inside-the-circle-is-the-affection` | low | says the closeness without saying it, and the direction is what proves it. |

**inferior** -- compilable

- fires on: being out of reach of the one person she counts on for long enough that she has stopped managing it
- stops on: the person answers warmly and at once, and the feeling settles
- the mode starts when the loneliness gauge reaches 90, which is its end
- the line while it is on: this is at its end: you have been out of reach of the one person who settles it for long enough that you have stopped managing it
- markers: sends more than one message in a row; opens the exchange; 「もういい」「別にいいけど」で切る

| code | band | what it does for her |
|---|---|---|
| `F6.read-a-thin-reaction-as-a-verdict` | rare | tests whether she is still being answered, without asking the question. |
| `F7.the-grievance-thrown-once-and-never-itemised` | rare | gets the anger out without becoming somebody who has been keeping score. |
| `F6.hold-on-harder-through-the-gap` | rare | keeps the tie in use while it cannot be used, which is what stops the gap becoming a verdict. |
